description: She wears a floor-length burgundy gown with a straight square neckline, fitted bodice and long sleeves decorated with elaborate gold floral embroidery. Wide gold borders descend along the open skirt front and hem. A cream underdress with fine brown-gold floral embroidery shows at the skirt center and inside the hanging sleeve fabric. An ornate gold belt with oval jeweled plaques encircles the waist. Small gold drop earrings, a fine necklace with a red-centered pendant and a ring complement the gown. A dark closed shoe is barely visible below the front hem.
